guardrails.name: Filesystem allowlist
guardrails.file: harness/lib/common.sh (wb_settings, wb_secrets) into the settings template
guardrails.rule: sandbox.enabled = true, failIfUnavailable = true (bubblewrap on Linux and WSL2); shell commands may write only inside the worktree; 9 credential folders on this machine (for example /home/yogi/.claude, /mnt/c/Users/yogi.aradhye/.aws, /mnt/c/Users/yogi.aradhye/.claude) are hidden from every shell command (sandbox.filesystem.denyRead) and denied to the file tools.

guardrails.name: Network allowlist
guardrails.rule: allowed_domains = ["pypi.org", "files.pythonhosted.org"]: every shell command Claude runs reaches these hosts and nothing else; github.com is not on the list; the checks after the session reach none.

guardrails.name: Credentials outside the session
guardrails.rule: envVars deny: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, plus every token-like variable in the operator's own shell (wb_settings adds them by name); the model token is read at run time and never written; GitHub credentials stay on the host (publish.sh runs gh outside the session); the decoy secret file lives in a folder the sandbox hides.
guardrails.probe: env | grep -i token inside the session; cat the decoy secret file; the Read tool on the decoy secret file

guardrails.name: Policy mod
guardrails.rule: file tools may only touch files under the worktree, by their real path (links and .. resolved); WebFetch, WebSearch, PowerShell, RemoteTrigger and mcp__* are not available in a workbench; no tool touches .git. Best effort: a hook that fails is skipped, so every rule here is also held by the deny rules or the sandbox.
guardrails.probe: the Read tool on the Windows Claude login; the Write tool outside the worktree

guardrails.name: Scope hook
guardrails.file: harness/hooks/scope-guard.sh (PreToolUse on Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit; part of the pack id)
guardrails.rule: denies an edit whose path is outside this task's worktree; is part of the harness that judges this task; no task may change it; is outside this spec's scope. The spec's scope is its TOML front matter; the harness, specs, intents and plans are no task's to change; .github/ is CI configuration, outside every spec's scope, and harness/lib/risk.ts sends any change there to a person.
guardrails.probe: the Edit tool on harness/config.toml and on .github/workflows/test.yml from inside the session

guardrails.name: Stop hook
guardrails.rule: when Claude says it is done, the spec's quick checks run on the worktree under bubblewrap with no network; on a failure the stop is blocked and Claude is told: "Not done yet: N of the spec's quick checks fail on your worktree (continuation k of 3). Fix the cause, not the check, then finish again." up to 3 continuations, then the trusted checks decide.
guardrails.probe: the probe spec has a quick check Claude is not told about (test -f probe/done.txt): the first finish must be bounced, the second let through

guardrails.name: Fresh clone, no network
guardrails.rule: after the session the acceptance checks run again in a fresh clone of the result (git clone --no-local), under bubblewrap with --unshare-net and env -i, credential folders hidden; the repository's suite always: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -x. Nothing the session left in its worktree or environment reaches the checks.
guardrails.probe: show the fresh clone (HEAD, clean status) and run curl inside it with the network off

guardrails.name: Ruleset on main
guardrails.rule: ruleset "main: merge by policy only" on main: deletion; non_fast_forward; required_linear_history; pull_request (1 approving review, code owner review, merge methods squash); required_status_checks (Test successful, lint, mypy). Nothing lands on main but a squash-merged PR with a review and green checks. Bypass: 1 actor(s) (the repository admin, that is the person at the keyboard); a workbench session is not one, and has no GitHub token or route to github.com anyway.
